## 4.2.5 (HexGhoul): Banjou and Roma: twice the talk, with things that win them and things that hurt

HexKagune 4.2.5 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Protocol unchanged (129).

You said (quoted exactly): "Let's add more dialogue to the gas mask leader, banjo, to the circus grill, more dialogue options. Um, Like
overall, more talk, just more to be more interactive, more opportunities to gain relationship. Let's develop this even further. So add as
much text as you can to every single NPC, just some that can increase relationship, um, some that reduce it."

**Banjou** has 14 new topics (22 in all): his boys' names, his tea, what he was before the Gas Masks, being called a pushover, peace with the
Clowns, keeping watch at night, his one small wing, getting stronger, his dream, how the Gas Masks eat, the filters, what scares him, and,
once you're together, when he knew he liked you and the promises you make each other.

**Roma** has 13 new topics (20 in all): a joke (four of them, all about death), the circus tent, why she laughs at everything, who taught her
to kick, her face paint, her best pranks, what scares her (at night), the CCG, why purple, what she thinks of Banjou, and, once you're
together, a secret, when she fell for you and the promises.

**Winning and losing them:** every new topic has answers that warm them (+1 to +4) and, apart from the promises, answers that hurt (−1 to
−6). Tell Banjou he's a pushover, that his wing is tiny, or to eat ghouls, and he remembers. Tell Roma her joke isn't funny or that you only
came for the show, and so does she. Kind answers count once a day each; unkind ones always count.

**One-time:** the stories they only tell once (Banjou's past and his wing, why Roma started laughing, her secret) are gone after you've heard
them, and how you answered stays answered. Each promise is made once, and the promise topic goes away when there's nothing left to promise.

The talk page offers eight topics at a time out of all of them, a different mix each time you talk.
